outcome_temp_id.description: Unique temporary ID for this outcome. Format: O001, O002, etc.

scenario_temp_id.description: MANDATORY: The scenario_temp_id from the scenario extraction step that this outcome belongs to. Every outcome MUST be linked to a scenario. If you cannot determine the scenario, create a new scenario entry or mark status as 'unclear'.

outcome_name.description: Name of the metric being reported. Use codebook field names when possible: cooling_demand, heating_demand, total_energy_use, carbon_emissions, discomfort_hours, indoor_temperature, MPMV, HIHH, IOD, HE, WBGT, HI, etc.

metric_group.description: Semantic category for this metric. Use: 'energy_demand', 'thermal_comfort', 'health_risk', 'thermal_resilience', 'indoor_environment', 'carbon_emissions', 'cost', 'other'.

value.description: The single numeric value reported for this outcome in this specific scenario. Extract one value per row. Do NOT pair baseline/intervention values in the same record.

unit.description: Unit of the reported value. Use original units as reported in the article.

room_or_space.description: Specific room, zone, or spatial unit the value refers to. Examples: 'bedroom', 'greatroom', 'living_room', 'whole_building', 'zone_1'. Null if the value applies to the whole building or is not space-specific.

occupant_group.description: The occupant population group this value applies to. Examples: 'elderly', 'non_elderly', 'children', 'general', 'not_applicable'. Null if the article does not differentiate by occupant group.

comparison_baseline_scenario_id.description: If this outcome is being explicitly compared to a baseline, provide the scenario_temp_id of that baseline scenario. Null if no explicit comparison is being made.

comparison_baseline_value.description: The baseline value this outcome is explicitly compared against, if such a comparison exists in the article. Null if no paired comparison is reported.

reported_effect_value.description: The difference or effect size as explicitly reported by the article (e.g., percentage reduction). Null if no effect is explicitly reported. Do NOT calculate this yourself.

reported_effect_unit.description: Unit of the reported effect. Examples: '%', 'kWh/m2', 'hours'. Null if no effect reported.

effect_direction.description: Direction of the effect. Use 'not_applicable' when the outcome is a standalone value with no comparison.

extraction_method.description: How the value was obtained. 'text': from article text. 'table': from a data table. 'figure_visual_confident': read from figure with high confidence. 'figure_visual_approximate': read from figure but approximate. 'calculated': derived by calculation. 'not_extracted': value could not be extracted.

confidence.description: Confidence in the extracted value. 'high': from text or clear table. 'medium': from figure read with reasonable accuracy. 'low': approximate or uncertain.

column_label.description: Column header or label in the source table/figure that contains this value.

needs_digitization.description: True ONLY if the value could not be read from a figure and requires manual digitization. If you were able to read the value (even approximately), set to false.

status.description: 'extracted': value confidently obtained. 'extracted_approximate': value read but approximate (e.g., from figure). 'not_found': value not in article. 'unclear': ambiguous. 'needs_digitization': requires manual digitization (value must be null). 'blocked': extraction blocked by a rule.
